name: Table
description: A static tabular structure containing rows and cells. It is not an interactive widget — it presents information without interactivity.
notes: <caption> is the table's name and must be the FIRST child of <table>. It is not the same as a nearby <h2>.
scope='col' and scope='row' on <th>. Without scope, browsers guess, and they guess wrong on any table that is not trivially simple.
A row header is <th scope='row'>, not <td>. The first cell of each row is usually a header.
For complex tables (multi-level or spanning headers), scope is not enough: use headers='id1 id2' on each <td> pointing at the <th> ids.
Do not use tables for layout (RAWeb 5.8). If you must, it needs role='presentation' and no <th>, <caption>, scope or headers.
A scrollable table container needs tabindex='0' so keyboard users can scroll it, plus role='region' and a name so it is announced.
Empty header cells are announced as nothing. Put text in them, or use a visually hidden label.

raweb_criteria.reason: A data table's title must be correctly associated with it — that is what <caption> does.
The title must actually describe the table's content.
Every column and row header must be declared with <th>.
Each cell must be associated with its headers — scope for simple tables, headers/id for complex ones.
A layout table must not use <th>, <caption>, scope or headers. (Better: do not use layout tables.)
Tables are the most common cause of horizontal scrolling at 320px. Wrap in a focusable scroll container.
